d: Platinum white hair is long, flowing, and straight with blunt bangs. The eyes are a glowing crimson shade with a sharp, intense expression. The face appears youthful and mature, paired with a slender, athletic build. The outfit consists of a dark navy and black sleek bodysuit with a high collar, asymmetrical cutouts, and a flowing cape of the same dark palette. Signature details include long black claw-like nail extensions and a large, ornate silver and glass gothic window structure in the background.
